name: 梅琳·皮尔扎达
name_full: 梅琳·皮尔扎达 Mehreen Pirzada
introduction: Mehreen Pirzada is an Indian actress and model who predominantly appears in Telugu, Tamil, Hindi and Punjabi films.Mehreen Pirzada was born in Bathinda, Punjab, in a Sikh family to an agriculturist and realtor father Gurlal Pirzada and a housewife mother Paramjit Kaur Pirzada. Her only sibling is a brother named Gurfateh Pirzada who is also a model and actor.
